notes.title: ver 1.1.14
notes.notes:
General bug fixes and tweaks
[list]
[*] reduced the max active creatures in Survival by 1 (makes it a little easier)
[*] pressing Y on the controller to start a NG+ now works
[*] added new option to disable Fog Blur [i](disabled by default on Steam Deck)[/i]
[*] performance fix for Steam Deck [i](previous update limited it to 30 FPS)[/i]
[/list]
Note, on Steam Deck the FPS are limited to 30 FPS when showing any menus (except for the Options menu) to reduce heat & battery usage.

Joypad tweaks to make it easier to aim:
[list]
[*] joypad sensitivity changes (i.e. smaller differences between each sensitivity option)
[*] reduced the Y axis joypad sensitivity
[*] increased time it takes to go to full accelerated turn speed
[*] reduced the max acceleration speed 
[/list]

notes.title: New Game Modes, Creatures and Achievements
notes.notes:
With the latest update, we have introduced some exciting new features. We appreciate all the feedback and comments that you have posted on the forums. Here is a breakdown of what we added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40897892/e5915f920ef32d22f7c7ed4dc2ef4f93be231019.jpg[/img]

[b]New Game Modes[/b]
We have added 3 new game modes that become active during and after the campaign is complete.
- Survival (Horde Mode): Face endless waves of enemies.
- Free Roam: Explore the open seascape without the threat of being attacked
- New Game +: Take on tougher challenges

[b]New Marine Life:[/b]
- Hammerhead shark
- Atlantic Goliath Grouper,
- Oriental Sweetlips.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40897892/8d02baf15ff6032896ea670e5fb79fc64813c9e4.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40897892/8a53f011f6ecacce57cbb70e5afbb1a8fbc21fd5.png[/img]

[b]Dynamic Underwater World:[/b]
-Real time water condition changes in Free Roam & Survival.

[b]Progress Seamlessly:[/b]
-Cloud save support.

[b]Achievements and Music[/b]
- 4 new Songs have been added
- 3 New Achievements have been included

[b]Enhanced Visuals and Fixes:[/b]
- FXAA and SMAA options for improved visuals.
- Object-based motion blur for realism.
- Bug fixes and optimizations.

[b]Other features and fixes:[/b]
- Added option to Skip Training
- Performance optimizations for Steam Deck
- Multiple save slots
- Start from any dive you have already completed
- Memory performance optimizations with sounds
- Fixed the bug with the Siren throwing the spear into the ground
- Fixed bug with game slowing down in upgrade menu if FXAA was enabled
- Fixed bug that made it look like bright glowing-coloured lights scattered all over

Thanks again for all your feedback and support you have shown us. We looking forward to rolling out the next update soon.

notes.title: The Atlantic Goliath Grouper
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=_yue3KJIjKs;full][/previewyoutube]

We're putting the finishing touches on the highly anticipated update for Death in the Water 2, packed with new features, enhanced graphical options, and new creatures. 

In the coming weeks, we'll unveil the full details of the update, However, we couldn't resist giving you a sneak peek at one of the most requested creature additions: the awe-inspiring Atlantic Goliath Grouper. This magnificent creature can reach lengths of over 8 feet and tip the scales at a staggering 800 pounds. Its presence in the eerie underwater horror landscape is truly a sight to behold.

What other else would you like us to add?

notes.title: ver 1.0.7
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] The game now includes a Unity bug fix that should prevent crashes some players were experiencing.
[*] Implemented 64-bit color, eliminating color banding issues.
[*] FidelityFX Super Resolution support has been added, with settings available in the options menu: Ultra Quality, Quality, Balanced, and Performance.
[*] Playing on a different computer no longer requires you to repeat the training.
[*] Improved performance significantly in the main menu.
[*] Options menu now doesn't show the glass background for the entire background allowing you to see a bit of the visual changes you make real-time.
[*] Made minor tweaks to the map.
[*] The sea surface collider is much bigger now which should prevent the bug where a shark would swim around it and end up above the water surface.
[/list]

notes.title: ver 1.0.6
notes.notes:
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Treasure chest icons now show a dot above or below them if the chest is higher or lower than your current height
[*] Treasure chest icons are now much brighter to make it easier to see they also show from further away and fade out closer to the chest
[*] many optimizations and performance improvements
[*] lighting improvements - creatures should now look more tied into the scene
[*] players spotlight will now cast light onto the weapon for more realism
[*] all seaweed now cast shadows
[*] Chaingun price reduced by 500 Gold
[*] Shotgun price increased by 1500 Gold
[*] Shotgun now does less damage to the Sand Tiger sharks
[*] Added Seaweed Density settings to the Options menu for extra performance
[*] Added a "Kill all possessed creatures" message when the Kraken arrives
[/olist]

[h2]Steam Deck[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Steam Deck - now loads the optimal settings for best performance and graphics (use "reset to default settings" if you already changed your settings)
[*] Steam Deck - now shows correct buttons on the menus to switch between tabs i.e. L1 & R1 instead of LB and RB
[*] Steam Deck - now uses larger fonts for the oxygen distance marker, multiplier, objectives text, and the subtitles
[/olist]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed Dive 7 radio message not playing at all
[*] Weapon Wheel - When using a Controller, it will now show the Controller icons to switch items instead of the keyboard buttons
[*] Fixed an issue that some players who started with ver 1.0.0 had where their save game would work
[*] Fixed the Gold value in the Upgrade screen getting cut off on certain screen resolutions
[*] Fixed the mouse aim acceleration speed being slow at 30 FPS
[*] Fixed an issue where changing the "Additional Light Shadows" from the Options menu whilst in game would not update immediately
[*] Fixed Blacktip Reef sharks in the training were not scaled correctly, making them look squished
[*] Improved Translations for French and Portuguese thanks to Gabriel Lira and Lucca Cardoso
[*] Other minor bug fixes
[/list]

[h3]Seaweed changes:[/h3]
